question.text: A broker wants to trade in IRD on a proprietary basis only, without algorithmic trading. What is the minimum Base Minimum Capital (BMC) required?

explanation.text: The Logic: The BMC tiers in the workbook are: only proprietary trading, no algo — Rs. 10 lacs; only client trading, no algo — Rs. 15 lacs; proprietary plus client trading, no algo — Rs. 25 lacs; all brokers with algo — Rs. 50 lacs. For proprietary-only, no algo, the requirement is Rs. 10 lakhs. The Trap: Rs. 25 lakhs is the BMC for proprietary plus client trading without algo, not for proprietary-only. Rs. 50 lakhs applies when algo trading is added. Rs. 75 lakhs is not a tier in the source table. Note: Source-backed to NISM-Series-IV workbook (Dec 2025), page 290 (BMC table); the sample question on page 295 also reflects Rs. 10 lakhs for this category.
